title: game/data/cutscenes/<id>.json: one cutscene: the map it is filmed on, its named spots, shots and lanes, what is cleared away while filming, and its script (docs/CUTSCENES.md)

point.description: a place on the map: [x, z] in metres, the map's own coordinates

point3.description: [x, height above the ground there, z] in metres

about.description: what the cutscene is and when it plays

map.description: the map it is filmed on (game/data/maps/<map>.json); when the map is part of a bigger view (a place's hub), its coordinates move with it

who.description: who says a line that names nobody (a speaker in story.json)

spots.description: named places people stand or walk to

fov.description: field of view in degrees (40 if left out)

w.description: a width in metres round the target that stays in frame on a narrow phone (0 if left out)

lanes.description: named paths for traffic (flying cars): [x, height, z] points

clear.description: props put out of the way while filming (not flat ones): inside an area, near a path between two spots, or near a point the camera stands at (props without a footprint only)

script.description: the story layer's lines and commands (docs/SCRIPTS.md, docs/CUTSCENES.md)
